findings.source_locator: hartogs.tex lines 31–37, transitivity of represented order types

findings.minimal_treatment: Use B subseteq A and disclose.

findings.source_locator: hartogs.tex lines 39–48, transported relation on injection range
findings.source_issue: The source uses f(alpha) even though the injection has domain alpha, and alpha cannot belong to a smaller beta.
findings.minimal_treatment: Use two ordinary indices gamma and delta in the domain, ordered by gamma in delta; disclose.

findings.source_issue: An order isomorphism from ordinal alpha to (A,R) is a function alpha to A with additional structure preservation, not a function whose codomain is the tuple itself.
findings.minimal_treatment: Use A and B as the respective function codomains, retaining isomorphism in prose; disclose.
